description: This file defines data structures and a class for managing watch notification inbox state and behavior in an Apple Watch app. It handles receiving messages, updating local state, persisting data, and scheduling local notifications.

classes.name: WatchInboxStore
classes.description: An observable class managing the state of notifications received by the Apple Watch, including persistence, notification handling, and user feedback mechanisms.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Processes an incoming notification message, updates state, and posts a local notification.

methods.name: restorePersistedState
methods.description: Restores the stored state from UserDefaults.

methods.name: deliveryKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a message to avoid duplicates.

methods.name: ensureNotificationAuthorization
methods.description: Requests notification permission if not already granted.

methods.name: mapHapticRisk
methods.description: Maps the risk string to a Haptic type for user feedback.

methods.name: makeReplyDraft
methods.description: Creates a reply draft based on a prompt action.

methods.name: markReplySending
methods.description: Updates state to indicate reply is being sent.

methods.name: markReplyResult
methods.description: Updates state based on the result of sending a reply.

methods.name: postLocalNotification
methods.description: Schedules a local notification and triggers haptic feedback.
